bibl.title: The Fayoum Survey Project: The Themistou Meris. Volume B. The Ceramological Survey
bibl.seg: Donald M. Bailey, with contributions by G. Pyke & R. Hartmann, The Fayoum Survey Project: The Themistou Meris. Volume B. The Ceramological Survey = Collectanea Hellenistica. IX.
Leuven - Paris - Bristol, CT, Peeters, 2019, viii-348 pp., figg. ISBN 978-90-429-3628-7. €96.
bibl.note: Preface [Cornelia Römer]. - Introduction. - 1. The meris (= district) of Themistos. Summary of sites. - 2. Ptolemaic imported black glaze ware. - 3. Ptolemaic finewares: Egyptian black and red glazed wares (EBGW1 and ERGW; or FRSW ware). - 4. Imported Eastern sigillata A ware and African red slip ware. - 5. Egyptian red slip A ware (ERSA), Aswan fine ware (AFW), Aswan red slip ware (ARSW), etc. and other Aswan wares. - 6. Egyptian red slip B Ware (ERSB), Fayumic red slip ware (FRSW) and Fayumic fineware (FFW). - 7. Egyptian plainware cups, bowls (and some casseroles). - 8. Cooking-pots and casseroles. - 9. Coarseware jars. - 10. Qawadis. - 11. Lekythoi, flagons and jugs, askoi, omphokerai and lids, juglets and lids. - 12. Miscellaneous and specialised vessels. - 13. Vitreous-glazed wares. - 14. Imported amphorae and Egyptian versions. - 15. Egyptian type A amphorae (Empereur AE 3). - 16. Egyptian Late Roman amphorae 7 (Hermopolis Magna type B). - 17. Lamps. - 18. Glass. - 19. Faience vessels. - 20. Miscellaneous objects. - Bibliography and bibliographical abbrevations. Plates of the pottery of the Themistou Meris. - Appendix I: Grenfell and Hunt at Harit and Kasr el-Banat: the ceramic material (by G. Pyke); - Appendix II: The Fayum Survey Project 1999-2006: The Ceramic Material from Watfa / Philoteris in the Publication of Donald M. Bailey (by R. Hartmann).
